place._theme: A non-hostile site, so the only guns are the Ecliptic crew on the array (who). Abandoned-only was a pool of 4 (lint, 2026-10-17), too narrow. The board places the POI, so it always starts (his, 2026-10-12).
place._residents: His 2026-10-28: "kill all the site inhabitants before spawning the enemies". Killed on the crew's stage, the line before the crew is placed (Eliza).
place._who: His 2026-10-28 play: "dull. You walk up to a place, shoot a box and the mission completes. Originally these were defended by there faction". The classic MB19 put Ecliptic guards on the nest (LCharEcliptic). So an Ecliptic crew round the first scanner, MB42a's built field.

prose.name: Sabotage: Ecliptic Scanners on <Planet>
prose.briefing: The Ecliptic have a scanner array at the <Place> watching everything that moves on <Planet>, and a crew sitting on it. The settlers who posted the job want every scanner destroyed.
prose.card: Local Contract. The Ecliptic are watching <Planet> through a scanner array at the <Place>, and they keep a crew on it. We need it destroyed, all of it, so they have to send someone out to look for themselves. Payment on completion.

recap: The Ecliptic scanners at the <Place> are wrecked, all three. Whatever the mercenaries want to know about <Planet> now, they'll have to come and see it with their own eyes.
recapSay: Their screens went dark all at once, and by the time they'd stopped calling it a fault we were packed and gone.

beats.objective: Destroy the Ecliptic scanners at the <Place>
beats.journal: This scanner was tracking movement on the ground. It isn't tracking anything now.
beats.name: Ecliptic Motion Scanner

beats.journal: This one counted ships landing and taking off. Whoever's watching will have to count them by eye.
beats.name: Ecliptic Landing Scanner

beats.journal: This scanner logged heat signatures, and it's in pieces now, still warm.
beats.name: Ecliptic Thermal Scanner

broadcast: That array's been watching every hauler we load for a month, and now they've parked a crew beside it. Take the scanners down, all of them, because the one you miss is the one that sees us leave.
_speech: The issuer on the radio once the job is taken. Voice is 05a and 18a's (wCizWKvnaS3LOIUwHo98); his ear decides. Radio rules: no names, no places, no factions spoken, no currency.
